'''Dutan Kelliv''' was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] and member of the [[Dutan nest]]. Kelliv worked for [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] munitions factory in [[Gallisport]], and supplied classified information to the nest regarding shipping schedules and security procedures.<ref name="AJ9" />
